FIRST ADDENDUM AMENDMENT 
 to Agreement to Sell by and between 
 Deevar Developers (Private) Limited (referred to as “Developer” ) and [•] [Buyer/Buyers Names] (individually, or in the case of joint buyers and collectively referred to as “Buyer " ) 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 This first a ddendum mendment (“ First A ddendum mendment ”) to Agreement to Sell dated [•] [INSERT DATE], (“ Agreement to Sell ”) is made and entered into at Lahore on this [•], 2022 (“ Effective Date ”). 
 WHEREAS 
 The Parties entered into the Agreement to Sell for the sale and purchase of the Unit No. [●] with total area [●] located at Zameen Opal, Plot No. 16 and 17, Land Breeze Society, Raiwind Road, Lahore (“ Unit ”); 
 The Developer had notified to the Buyer through a Letter of Intimation of Zameen Opal dated [•] [DATED] about the continued surge in prices of Component Materials which has prompted an adjustment in the Purchase Price to the extent of the Adjusted Amount under Clause 3.3 and the Buyer has acknowledged such adjustment; 
 Furthermore, subject to the Buyer fulfilling his/her obligation under the Agreement to Sell including the payment of instalments under the revised P ayment P lan appended to this First A ddendum mendment , t he Developer ha s agreed to grant exclusive license to occupy in favour of the Buyer ; a nd 
 P ursuant to Clause 1 5 . 2 of the Agreement , the Parties hereby mutual ly agree to revise , amend and supplement the Agreement in accordance with the terms and conditions hereof. 
 
 NOW , THEREFORE, the P arties agree as follows: 
 The First A ddendum mendment shall be effective from the Effective Date . 
 The Payment Plan specified in Attachment B of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced with the Payment Plan specified in Attachment B/1 appended to this First A ddendum mendment . For the avoidance of doubt, the Payment Plan in Attachment B shall have no force or effect as of the Effective Date. Any and all references to Attachment B in the Agreement shall be deemed to be reference to Attachment B/1 appended to this First A ddendum mendment . 
 
 The Developer hereby grants to the Buyer an exclusive license to occupy the Unit for [●] months ( “License” ) subject to the Buyer fulfilling his/her obligation and responsibilities under the Agreement to Sell including the payment of remaining instalments as per the revised Payment Plan e appended to this First A ddendum mendment . 
 The Buyer shall not have the any right to sub- license , lease, sell or encumbered the Unit in any manner whatsoever during the License period and the License granted under Clause 3 above shall be exercised strictly in accordance with the Rules and terms of the License . The Buyer acknowledges that the Buyer only has the license to occupy and sub license the Unit and the License does not create or transfer any right, title or interests in the Unit in favour of the Buyer. 
 In the event the Buyer fails to fulfill his/her obligation under the Agreement to Sell including the payment of remaining instalments as per the revised Payment Plane appended to this First A ddendum mendment , the Developer shall be entitled to revoke the License and upon revocation of the License the Buyer shall peacefully handover the vacant possession the Unit to the Developer. 
 The Buyer agrees to furnish the following pos t e dated cheques in favour of the Developer , with unconditional right to encash them, as a promise to pay in future the remaining instalments as per the P ayment P lan: 
 Rs. [●] (Rupees ●in words] via cheque number [●], dated [●], drawn on Bank [●]. 
 Rs. [●] (Rupees ●in words] via cheque number [●], dated [●], drawn on Bank [●]. 
 Rs. [●] (Rupees ●in words] via cheque number [●], dated [●], drawn on Bank [●]. 
 The scanned copy of the postdated cheque issued under this clause is attached in the Annexure [●]. 
 The Buyer further agrees and acknowledges that in the event any of the banker’s cheques referred to in Clause 5 is dishonored or payment is refused by the issuing bank for any reason whatsoever, in addition to any other remedy available to the Developer , the Developer shall have the right to initiate proceedings under the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860 and any other applicable laws against the Buyer . 
 Clause 5 .2 of Agreement to Sell is hereby reviewed and revised as follows: 
 “ The Developer shall issue the Completion Notice to the Buyer communicating the Completion Date and informing the Buyer to make all outstanding payments as per the payment plan, under the Agreement. The Completion Date may be earlier or later than the Estimated Completion Date. In the event that the Completion Date is earlier than the Estimated Completion Date, the Buyer may postpone possession up to (but no later than) the Estimated Completion Date. ” 
 Clause 5.3 of the Agreement to Sell is hereby reviewed and revised as follows: 
 “ On the Completion Date, subject to terms of this Agreement, the Developer shall transfer vacant possession of the Unit to the Buyer as per the terms of License. Upon completion of payments under the payment plan, the Developer shall issue Allotment Letter and shall render all reasonable assistance to the Buyer, including issuance of NOC for recording of Buyer’s rights in the Unit in the relevant department / revenue record, if requested by the Buyer. The Developer shall have the right to revoke the License and evict the Buyer from the Unit where the Buyer is not in compliance with its obligations under the Agreement. For the avoidance of doubt, recording of the Buyer’s rights in the relevant department / revenue record shall be at the discretion and cost of the Buyer. ” 
 Clause 5.4 of the Agreement to Sell is hereby reviewed and revised as follows: 
 “ In the event, the Buyer fails to take over possession of the Unit as pre the terms of License on the Completion Date, for any reason whatsoever, then all risks, responsibilities and obligations associated with the Unit shall pass to the Buyer as and from the Completion Date, whereas rights in the Unit shall be transferred upon fulfillment of all obligations and responsibilities of the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell including completion of payments as specified in the Payment Plan. In addition, the Buyer shall be obligated to pay a monthly fee for each month he fails to take possession ” 
 
 The Developer shall obtain and, to the extent possible, assign to the Buyer the benefit of any manufacturers’ warranties, in respect of any fixtures or fittings installed by or on behalf of the Developer in the Purchased Unit. The Developer makes no independent representation or warranty as regards the fitness for use or quality of appliances, fittings or fixtures and has relied on the manufacturers'/suppliers' representations and warranties in this regard. The maintenance and/or replacement of all appliances in the Purchased Unit shall be covered by the warranties of respective manufacturers issued at the time of purchase of such appliances and the Developer shall have no liability thereof including any extension in the warranty periods of such warranties. 
 This First A dd endum mendment shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement. 
 All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis, and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of the First A ddendum mendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately. 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning in this First A ddendum mendment , unless otherwise specified. 
 The First A ddendum mendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same addendum amendment . 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Addendum , having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses .
